messages:
maiya: Post-deploy quicklook for canary rollout v2026.03.23 -> rolling.
maiya: TL;DR: most synthetic probes OK, prefix/KV warmup still ramping in eu-west1, tiny 1.2% 5xx on /embed-route (p95 latency +8ms). Holding soft for a minute to decide.
deploy-bot: automated smoke summary: canary=20% traffic, eu-west1 shard: synth_success=97.6%, synth_5xx=1.2%, kv_warmup=35% warmed, p95=68ms. Logs attached -> /deploy/logs/1723456789
devin: any pattern on errors? tokenization/oom/timeout?
olga: quick grep shows a bunch of 502s from inference-proxy with `context canceled` around 1723456760
samir: 502s are concentrated on embed route, looks like backend model variant (quant-v2) had a few backpressure events during warmup.
maiya: OK. Proposal: pause traffic bump for eu-west1, keep global rollout going but pin embed-route to previous model variant for that region. 15min hold, extra sampling on tail latency.
natalie: good call. I'll add a line in the release notes: "temporary regional pin on embed-route in eu-west1 due to warmup tail latency" and link follow-up ticket.
sre-bot: metric snapshot: cpu/gpu utilization stable, queue length on infer-proxy spiked to 12 for ~3m at 17:46 UTC. Heap growth negligible. Link: https://telemetry/redwood/snap/1723456789
devin: how do we pin? quick command?
maiya: run: `rcli rollout pin --route embed-route --region eu-west1 --model-id s-20260322-v1`
maiya: deploy-bot, can you apply soft pin and confirm?
deploy-bot: applying soft pin...
deploy-bot: success: soft pin applied for embed-route in eu-west1 -> s-20260322-v1. Traffic adjusted: canary eu-west1 -> 10% to new, 90% pinned.
maiya: we'll keep the overall rollout at 20% global but eu-west1 at reduced exposure until warmup metrics show kv_warmup >= 80% and synth_5xx < 0.5% for 10m.
samir: can we enable extra KV prefill for eu-west1 to speed warmup? small script: `kv-prefill --route embed-route --region eu-west1 --concurrency 4 --duration 600s`
olga: launched kv-prefill job (job id 1723456795), monitoring logs.
maiya: thanks. if we see 5xx trend down in next 10min we continue; if not, we'll roll back the canary to previous release across region and open postmortem.
natalie: created ticket RW-8674 "eu-west1 embed-route warmup tail latency" and added owners: @maiya @samir @olga. Release notes updated.
maiya: final: hold window 15m starting now, sampling increased to 2x tail, follow-up doc in #eng-releases for handoff. :white_check_mark:
maiya: followup: assigned RW-8674, next update by 1723456812.
